question: Owner 2026-10-27: the spike paper score is only known at the 5m touch close, too late to rest a live limit. Layered alternative: rest on the previous-close score (A), confirm with the touch-bar score at the touch close and exit if it fails (B), and for levels touched without a resting order enter at market at the touch close with the stop unchanged (C). Which combination keeps return and cuts drawdown?
single_variable: Per variant one layer against its comparator: rest vs the leaky v3_be0 ledger (selection score bar), rest_chk vs rest (fill-close exit), late vs no trade and vs the leaky limit fill of the same event (entry at the touch close). Exits, stops, fees and data frozen.
exits: v3: range 0.618 below 0.6, opposite 1618 from 0.6 (by pre for resting orders, by full for late), -30 percent backstop from the level, 60m reclaim, breakeven at the level

fees.source: Codex config maker_fee / taker_fee (OKX Lv1 0.02 / 0.05 percent, read 2026-10-23)

parity: rest rows whose v3 target mode by pre equals that by full and with full >= 0.5 must equal the reference v3_be0 rows on both paths
replay: monday_limit_return_opt.frac N20 3x (the v3add20 sizing, base legs only, no add legs), median of 10 seeds from 20261103; periods 2020-2024 / 2025 / 2026 / last five months
not_run: 1m spike entry (needs 1m bars through each trade); add legs
null_control: Each layer is compared with its own counterfactual on identical events: the same event held (rest) or filled at the limit (reference) or not traded.
